segments.html: language

A causal-language-model name over TransformersModel (deprecated).

TransformersModel already generates through the model and returns token ids (see its generate), so LanguageModel adds nothing of its own — it just pins the text-generation task and takes tokenizer_kwargs at load. Prefer TransformersModel(repo_id, task="text-generation") directly; this name is kept for backwards compatibility and warns on construction.

Bases: TransformersModel

Deprecated: a TransformersModel pinned to the text-generation task.

Use TransformersModel(repo_id, task="text-generation") instead. Everything this class offered — generate returning token ids, pipe running the pipeline, trace, scan — lives on TransformersModel now; the only extra here is tokenizer_kwargs (apply the same settings to model.tokenizer yourself, padding_side being the usual one).
